sentences.zh: 他们为什么会在这个伍基人的星球上？

我们为什么要偷偷摸摸的？

sentences.zh: 他们炸毁了整个星球，对吧？

sentences.zh: 在《星球大战》炸毁星球的大团圆结局之后，现在在这个圣诞特辑里，

But they didn't obliterate the entire-

sentences.zh: 他们并没有除掉帝国军队。

sentences.zh: 但他们几乎除掉了里面所有人。

sentences.zh: 他们除掉了那台漂浮的死亡射线机器。

sentences.zh: 炸掉死星到底有什么意义？

sentences.zh: 四秒钟后，大家又开始怕那些军官了吗？

sentences.zh: 顺便问一下，谁负责指挥？

sentences.zh: 还有，我们为什么要看这个帝国军官逛小商品店？

sentences.en: My favorite moment, I think we need to hear it, when we learn that you can buy a pocket aquarium.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的一个片段，我觉得大家得听听，就是我们发现原来还能买到袖珍水族箱的时候。

sentences.en: Listen to his reaction to this gadget.
sentences.zh: 听听他对这个小玩意的反应。

And the tank is a snap to clean.
sentences.zh: 鱼缸清理起来也特别方便。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, I live for this guy.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说，我就是为了看这家伙才活着的。

sentences.en: His voice, his reaction to everything.
sentences.zh: 他的声音，他对每件事的反应。

sentences.en: Well, at the end of the scene, Sean Dan is going to convince the officer that he needs this special groomer.

sentences.en: And he's going to discuss the multiple uses of the groomer with the officer.

能清洁牙齿、手指和脚趾甲。

sentences.en: Just the thing to keep you squeaky clean.
sentences.zh: 这正是让你保持一尘不染的神器。

sentences.en: And you guys, if you see it, it's like a stick with a brush on the end.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，如果你们看到了，它就像一根顶端带着刷子的棍子。

sentences.en: Well, after this, we are going to cut to Darth Vader.
sentences.zh: 好了，在这之后，我们要切到达斯·维达的镜头。

sentences.en: Darth Vader tells his henchmen that he wants to find and identify the rebels, even if it means searching every home in the system.
sentences.zh: 达斯·维达告诉他的手下，他要找到并确认那些反叛军，哪怕这意味着要搜查星系里的每一户人家。

sentences.en: I have a fun fact for you.
sentences.zh: 我有个有趣的事实要告诉你。

sentences.en: James Earl Jones is the voice of Darth Vader, but he was originally uncredited in the Star Wars movies.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·厄尔·琼斯是达斯·维达的配音，但他最初在《星球大战》电影中并没有署名。

sentences.en: So this special marks the first time he was actually credited as the voice of Darth Vader.
sentences.zh: 所以这部特辑标志着他第一次真正以达斯·维达配音演员的身份出现在演职员表中。

sentences.zh: 我们要回到伍基人的家，因为特辑的大部分内容都发生在那里。

sentences.zh: 这是他饰演的三个角色之一。

sentences.zh: 哈维·科曼因在《卡罗尔·伯内特秀》中的角色而声名鹊起。

sentences.en: During his 10-year run on the show, he received six Emmy nominations, and he won four.
sentences.zh: 在该节目播出的十年间，他获得了六次艾美奖提名，并赢得了四次。

sentences.en: He also starred in the Mel Brooks films Blazing Saddles and High Anxiety and the Disney film Herbie Goes Bananas.
sentences.zh: 他还出演了梅尔·布鲁克斯的电影《灼热的马鞍》和《高压危机》，以及迪士尼电影《金龟车大闹南美洲》。

sentences.en: And I was relieved when this bit came up.
sentences.zh: 当这一段出现时，我松了一口气。

sentences.en: I did appreciate this comedy bit.
sentences.zh: 我确实很欣赏这段喜剧表演。

sentences.en: Well, that's what he's there for.
He is wearing a gray sort of pompadour wig with a pink dress and a cape.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一顶灰色的蓬巴杜假发，穿着粉红色的裙子，披着斗篷。

sentences.en: His hands have these big gloves that come up.
sentences.zh: 他的手上戴着那种长到手臂的大手套。

sentences.en: There might be more hands coming.
sentences.zh: 可能还会有更多只手出现。

sentences.en: Chef Gormanda is teaching you how to make Bantha Surprise.
sentences.zh: 戈曼达厨师正在教你如何制作班萨惊喜。

sentences.en: This is a traditional dish served on Life Day, and Mala is following the instructions.
sentences.zh: 这是生命日的一道传统菜肴，玛拉正在按照说明操作。

sentences.en: It seems like the way you make it is you just kind of whip things into a frenzy.
sentences.zh: 看起来制作方法就是把各种东西搅在一起，搅到疯狂。

sentences.en: Step one, we stir the mixture.
sentences.zh: 第一步，我们搅拌混合物。

sentences.en: Stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir, stir.

sentences.zh: 搅，打，打，打，搅，搅，搅，搅，搅，搅，搅，搅，搅，搅，搅，搅，

sentences.zh: 在所有的搅拌和抽打过程中，戈曼达长出了第三只手，然后是第四只手。

sentences.en: After that segment, Gourmanda's like, you also got to beat it.
sentences.zh: 在那段之后，戈曼达说，你还得把它打匀。

sentences.en: So then another arm comes out to beat it.
sentences.zh: 于是又伸出另一只手来打。

sentences.en: And then you've got to taste it.
And another comes out to taste it.
sentences.zh: 于是又伸出一只手来尝。

sentences.en: And then there's four arms going.
I mean, Harvey is trying to keep up that one of the arms is feeding him.
sentences.zh: 我是说，哈维试图跟上节奏，其中一只手还在喂他吃。

sentences.en: His wig starts to fall apart.
Angela, did you know what Banthas were?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你知道班萨是什么吗？

sentences.en: They serve as mounts for Tuscan raiders.
sentences.zh: 它们是塔斯肯袭击者的坐骑。

sentences.en: And the two share a close, almost mystical bond.
sentences.zh: 两者之间有着紧密的、近乎神秘的联系。

sentences.en: They look like a giant, like, sheep, woolly mammoth.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来就像巨大的，呃，绵羊，长毛猛犸象。

sentences.en: I know what they are now.
sentences.zh: 我现在知道它们是什么了。

sentences.en: I just didn't know the name.
sentences.zh: 我只是不知道名字而已。

sentences.en: Is this kind of like eating a horse then?
I mean, it feels like it's eating a unicorn because the thing has a mystical bond with its rider.
sentences.zh: 我是说，感觉就像在吃独角兽，因为那东西和它的骑手有种神秘的联系。

sentences.en: Or eating a dragon or eating a dragon or something.
sentences.zh: 或者吃龙，或者吃龙之类的东西。

sentences.en: I'll have you all know that if you would like, you can purchase the Star Wars Life Day Cookbook.
sentences.zh: 我要告诉大家，如果你们愿意，可以去买《星球大战生命日食谱》。

sentences.en: I'm holding it in my hands right now.
It contains, quote, official holiday recipes from a galaxy far, far away.
sentences.zh: 里面包含了，引用一下，“来自遥远银河系的官方节日食谱”。

sentences.en: And this was released after the holiday special.
sentences.zh: 这是在节日特辑之后发布的。

sentences.en: And there is a recipe for Bantha surprise, which I thought maybe Josh could make for us.
sentences.zh: 里面有个“班萨惊喜”的食谱，我想也许乔什能为我们做。

sentences.en: Josh was like, Ange, I just got a really weird email from Jenna.
sentences.zh: 乔什说，安吉，我刚收到珍娜发来的一封很奇怪的邮件。

sentences.en: I was like, what do you mean?
She was like, she wants me to make a type of stew for the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 她说，她想让我为播客做一种炖菜。

sentences.en: If you look at the recipe, it is basically a recipe for beef stew.
sentences.zh: 如果你看那个食谱，它基本上就是炖牛肉的食谱。

sentences.en: It's got carrots and onions, celery.
sentences.zh: 里面有胡萝卜、洋葱和芹菜。

sentences.en: And so I'm excited to try it.
Well, the human version, the recipe calls for beef rather than Bantha.
sentences.zh: 嗯，人类版本，食谱里用的是牛肉而不是班萨肉。

sentences.en: And Cassie, I know you're a vegetarian and you won't be able to partake.
sentences.zh: 凯西，我知道你是素食主义者，不能吃这个。

sentences.en: So I did make us a special punch, according to the Life Day Cookbook that you can have.
sentences.zh: 所以我根据《生命日食谱》为我们特制了一种你可以喝的潘趣酒。
它叫乔·布拉斯托潘趣酒。

sentences.en: Do you know who Joe Blasto is?
sentences.zh: 你知道乔·布拉斯托是谁吗？

sentences.en: I guess Joe Blasto is a classic Husties Life Day jingle.
sentences.zh: 我猜乔·布拉斯托是一首经典的赫斯蒂生命日短曲。

sentences.en: Joe Blasto is a song, not a person.
sentences.zh: 乔·布拉斯托是一首歌，不是一个人。

sentences.en: The song is not in the special.
sentences.zh: 这首歌不在特别节目里。

sentences.en: You sing it on Life Day?

sentences.zh: 然后这是食谱里的歌词。

sentences.en: It's written in both Wookiee and English.
sentences.zh: 它既有伍基语版本，也有英语版本。

sentences.en: Do you want me to do the Wookiee part with my mask and you do the English part?
sentences.zh: 你想让我戴着面具唱伍基语部分，你唱英语部分吗？

sentences.en: Rumor has it that R3X, the DJ droid over at Oga's Cantina, has a collection of Joe Blasto remixes so extensive that it could play all life day without ever repeating.
sentences.zh: 有传言说，奥加酒馆的DJ机器人R3X收藏了海量的乔·布拉斯托混音曲，甚至可以整整一个生命日循环播放都不带重样的。

sentences.en: I love that you're standing over my shoulder as if this means anything to you.
sentences.zh: 我真喜欢你站在我肩后，好像这东西对你有什么意义似的。

sentences.en: And I'll sing this part in a melody that I make up on the spot.
sentences.zh: 然后我会用我当场编的旋律唱这一段。

sentences.en: And then I'll sing the Wookiee part.
sentences.zh: 接着我会唱伍基语部分。
乔·布拉斯托，乔·布拉斯托，布拉斯托。
穆里-拉，欧-塔-潘-瓦-雅-塔-卡。

sentences.en: No one wants to hear that.
No one wants to hear us do that.
I don't even want to hear us do that.
sentences.zh: 连我自己都不想听我们唱那个。

sentences.en: We've now just made our own show holiday special.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚自制了一档节目特别篇。

sentences.en: Everybody, we are going to take a break.
We're going to get out the Bantha surprise.
sentences.zh: 我们要去端出班萨惊喜料理。

sentences.en: I'm going to get out the Joe Blasto punch, and we'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我要去拿乔·布拉斯托潘趣酒，我们马上回来。
我们拿到了班萨惊喜料理。
安斯利也是素食主义者。

sentences.en: So, Sam, Angela, let's try our Bantha surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以，萨姆，安吉拉，我们来尝尝班萨惊喜料理吧。
我的意思是，这就是炖菜。

sentences.en: If you base the movie off of this, this movie's great.
sentences.zh: 如果电影是根据这个来拍的，那电影肯定很棒。

sentences.en: We'll, we'll put the recipe in our stories.
sentences.zh: 我们会把食谱发到我们的快拍里。

sentences.en: And Josh, we'll show you how to make it.
sentences.zh: 还有乔什，我们会教你怎么做。

sentences.en: Now, let me try my punch.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我尝尝我的潘趣酒。

sentences.en: By the way, the punch, I should tell you what's in it.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，这酒，我得告诉你里面有什么。

sentences.en: This punch is insane, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这酒简直绝了。

sentences.en: I need a sip of water.
I don't think I can go from beef stew to this.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我没法从牛肉炖菜直接过渡到这个。

sentences.en: It looks like, it looks like a rainbow ice cream in a cup.
sentences.zh: 它看起来，看起来就像杯子里的彩虹雪酪。

sentences.en: It is cranberry juice, pineapple juice, 7-Up.
sentences.zh: 它是蔓越莓汁、菠萝汁和七喜。

sentences.en: And then you mix that together and you top it with a scoop of rainbow sherbet.
sentences.zh: 然后把它们混合在一起，上面再加一勺彩虹雪酪。

sentences.en: Everybody, and Ainsley, Cassie, you've got some.
sentences.zh: 大家，还有安斯利、卡西，你们也来点。

sentences.en: It was more tart than I expected.

sentences.zh: 像这种浓郁的牛肉炖菜。

sentences.en: I can't believe you didn't take a sip of water between the two.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信你在两者之间竟然没喝口水。

sentences.en: Okay, let me take another sip.

sentences.zh: 舌头的各个部位都感受到了。

sentences.en: It makes my mouth want to expel it.
sentences.zh: 这味道让我嘴里想把它吐出来。

sentences.en: I don't know if it's because I've had the mayonnaise and olives, but I'm like, this ain't so bad.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是不是因为我之前吃了蛋黄酱和橄榄，但我感觉，这其实没那么糟。

sentences.en: Like, nothing can ever be as bad as that.
sentences.zh: 反正没什么能比那个更糟糕了。

sentences.en: Ainsley, Cassie, how did you like the punch?
sentences.zh: 安斯利，凯西，你们觉得这果汁怎么样？

sentences.en: It tastes exactly the way it looks, and kind of like what I imagine unicorn droppings to taste like.
sentences.zh: 尝起来跟看起来一模一样，感觉就像我幻想中独角兽粪便的味道。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's way too tart, but it's close, but not as good as this punch my grandma makes for the holidays,
sentences.zh: 是啊，太酸了，虽然接近了，但没法跟我奶奶节日做的果汁比，

sentences.en: which is just high C, ginger ale, and sherbet.
sentences.zh: 她那个就是用高C果汁、姜汁汽水和果子露做的。

sentences.en: And that's really sweet and yummy and highly recommend.
sentences.zh: 那个特别甜，特别好喝，强烈推荐。

sentences.en: Well, Ainsley, you saw me make it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，安斯利，你看着我做的。

sentences.en: I measured it per the instructions.
sentences.zh: 我是按说明书上的量放的。

sentences.en: It looks like something like when our kids were young and we played potion, you know, like, make your own potion.
sentences.zh: 这看起来就像我们孩子小时候玩的那种药水游戏，你知道的，就是自己调配药水。

sentences.en: And it was like, what do we got in the kitchen that I'll let them pour into a cup?
sentences.zh: 当时就是想，厨房里有什么东西是我能让他们倒进杯子里的？

sentences.en: Oh, you know what it looks like when you get one of those lush bath bombs?
sentences.zh: 噢，你知道它看起来像什么吗？就像那种奢华的沐浴炸弹？

sentences.en: And it gets all frothy and rainbowy and then-

I would pass on the Joe Blasto punch.
sentences.zh: 至于“乔·布拉斯特”果汁，我还是算了吧。

sentences.en: Well, let's keep going with our breakdown.
But I want to say I haven't hated this experience.
sentences.zh: 但我得说，我并不讨厌这次体验。

sentences.en: I feel like maybe my tone so far is communicating a type of grumpiness.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我刚才的语气可能传达出了一种暴躁的感觉。

sentences.en: That's the highest compliment Jenna Fisher can give.
sentences.zh: 那可是珍娜·费舍尔能给出的最高评价了。

sentences.en: This experience, I look back on it with fondness in a way.
sentences.zh: 这次体验，回想起来我甚至觉得还有点美好。

sentences.en: We're going to get back on the Millennium Falcon again and Han Solo is still having a hard time getting Chewie to his home planet.
sentences.zh: 我们要再次回到千年隼号上了，汉·索罗还在为送楚巴卡回母星而发愁。

sentences.en: Well, lady, the coordinates weren't the best and they came out of hyperspace into an Imperial convoy.
sentences.zh: 好吧，女士，坐标不太准，他们从超空间跳出来时正好撞进了一个帝国护航队。

sentences.en: I've got some gems from Han Solo.
sentences.zh: 我从汉·索罗那里搜集了一些金句。

sentences.en: This is one life day we won't soon forget.
sentences.zh: 这是我们难忘的一个生命日。

sentences.en: And this one, why do I always think taking you home for life day is going to be easy?
sentences.zh: 还有这句，为什么我总觉得带你回家过生命日会很容易？

sentences.en: Why does he always think that?
I just lost control of the remote cannons.
sentences.zh: 我刚失去了对遥控炮塔的控制。

sentences.en: I got to go to the back and operate them manually.
sentences.zh: 我得去后面手动操作它们。

sentences.en: How do you operate them manually?
We don't spend too much time.
Well, now the Empire is going to declare martial law.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在帝国要宣布戒严了。

sentences.en: No ships are going to be permitted in or out without further notice.
sentences.zh: 在另行通知前，任何飞船都不准进出。

sentences.en: I have one thing to say.
The number of times the Empire has to pop on your TV screen, it's constant.
sentences.zh: 帝国出现在你电视屏幕上的次数，简直没完没了。

sentences.en: They're popping up all the time to tell you something.
sentences.zh: 他们总是突然冒出来告诉你些什么。

sentences.en: I'm like, can you turn it off?
sentences.zh: 我就想，能不能把它关掉？

sentences.en: Do you have to have these people just popping up at your bar, at your home?
sentences.zh: 难道这些人非得在你的酒吧、你的家里这样突然冒出来吗？

sentences.en: Also, I guess they can see you.
sentences.zh: 而且，我猜他们能看见你。

sentences.en: They can just pop up and they see you.
sentences.zh: 他们随时都能冒出来，而且能看见你。

sentences.en: Like, what if you're walking through your house like post-shower and they just pop up on your screen?
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你刚洗完澡在家里走动，他们突然出现在屏幕上怎么办？

sentences.en: I didn't think they could see you.
I thought you could only see them.
sentences.zh: 我以为只能你看见他们。

sentences.en: Well, now Sean Dan is going to come over to the Wookiee home.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在肖恩·丹要来伍基人的家里了。

sentences.en: He's got a toy for Lumpy and I thought it was a sewing machine for Mala, but it's not.
sentences.zh: 他给兰比带了个玩具，我本以为那是给玛拉的缝纫机，但并不是。

sentences.en: I don't know what he gives Mala, but before he gives her the gift.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他给了玛拉什么，但在他送礼物之前。

sentences.en: She got to give him a little kiss on the cheek.
sentences.zh: 她得在他的脸颊上亲一下。

sentences.en: For a gift she didn't ask for.
sentences.zh: 就为了一个她根本没要的礼物。

sentences.en: Why, why, why doesn't Sean Dan's shirt have a button or a zipper?
sentences.zh: 为什么，为什么，为什么肖恩·丹的衬衫没有扣子或拉链？

sentences.en: It is like all the way to his navel.
sentences.zh: 它一直开到他的肚脐眼。

sentences.en: A lot of open real estate there.
sentences.zh: 那儿露出的面积可真够大的。

sentences.en: He is going to give Itchy a proton pack so that he can get his mind evaporator working.
sentences.zh: 他要给伊奇一个质子背包，好让他的思维蒸发器运转起来。

sentences.en: It's like he sits down in like an old timey hair salon dryer.
sentences.zh: 他就像坐在那种老式的理发店烘发机下面一样。

sentences.en: And, you know, he kind of leans down to Itchy and kind of smirks and goes, I mean, this is wow.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，他凑近伊奇，带着那种坏笑说，我是说，这真是哇哦。

sentences.en: And then if you know what I mean, happy life day.
sentences.zh: 如果你懂我的意思的话，生命日快乐。

sentences.en: And I do mean happy life day.
sentences.zh: 我是说真的，生命日快乐。

sentences.en: I'm like, what's with the creepy dialogue?
sentences.zh: 我就想，这毛骨悚然的对话是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And what's with the creepy dialogue?
sentences.zh: 这毛骨悚然的对话到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: It's foreshadowing for what we're about to see.
sentences.zh: 这是在为我们即将看到的内容做铺垫。
接下来发生的事是这样的。

sentences.en: Itchy puts this virtual reality headset on.
sentences.zh: 伊奇戴上了这个虚拟现实头盔。

sentences.en: And then Mermia is this very sexy holographic image played by Diane Carroll.
sentences.zh: 然后默米亚出现了，那是一个由黛安·卡罗尔扮演的非常性感的全息影像。

sentences.en: I just want you guys to hear.
I want you to hear some of the things she's saying.
sentences.zh: 我想让你们听听她说的一些话。

sentences.en: She's wearing a sparkly wig and this off the shoulder gown.
sentences.zh: 她戴着一顶闪亮的假发，穿着这件露肩礼服。

sentences.en: So just imagine Diane Carroll looking incredible.
sentences.zh: 所以，想象一下戴安·卡罗尔看起来有多迷人。

sentences.en: This is the gift that Sean gives to the grandpa.
sentences.zh: 这是肖恩送给爷爷的礼物。

sentences.en: We can have a good time.
She says it over and over.
Grandpa is sitting in the middle of the kitchen getting off.
sentences.zh: 爷爷坐在厨房中间，正乐在其中。

sentences.en: She's going to go on to say things like, I am your fantasy.
sentences.zh: 她接下来会说诸如“我是你的幻想”之类的话。

sentences.en: Then she's going to perform a song.
This was an original song written for the special called This Minute Now.
sentences.zh: 这是一首为特别节目《此时此刻》创作的原创歌曲。

sentences.en: And it is the least melodic song I've ever heard in my life.
sentences.zh: 而且这是我这辈子听过最没旋律感的歌。

sentences.en: And I thought we should listen to some of it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该听听看。

sentences.en: Because there's one more coming up that's going to give it a run for its money.
sentences.zh: 因为后面还有一首，足以和这首一较高下。

sentences.en: If we could only bend this minute, infinitely extend this minute, then I could live my whole life.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能弯曲这一分钟，无限延长这一分钟，那我就可以过完我的一生。

sentences.en: Okay, I can't anymore with it.
It sounds like when you sing to your cat or when you sing to your pets.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像你对着猫或者宠物唱歌一样。

sentences.en: Can I talk to you, though, about Diane Carroll?
sentences.zh: 不过，我能跟你聊聊戴安·卡罗尔吗？

sentences.en: Diane Carroll is such a freaking badass.
sentences.zh: 戴安·卡罗尔真是个超级狠角色。

sentences.en: She was an actress, a singer, a model, and an activiSt.
sentences.zh: 她是一位演员、歌手、模特和活动家。

sentences.en: She starred in this television show called Julia.
sentences.zh: 她主演了一部叫《朱莉娅》的电视剧。

sentences.en: Julia, and this role was significant because it was the first American television show to star a Black woman in a non-stereotypical role.
sentences.zh: 《朱莉娅》，这个角色意义重大，因为它是第一部由黑人女性担任主角且角色不带刻板印象的美国电视剧。

sentences.en: And she won the Golden Globe for her performance.
sentences.zh: 她还凭借这个角色赢得了金球奖。

sentences.en: She also received an Emmy nomination.
sentences.zh: 她还获得了艾美奖提名。

sentences.en: She didn't win, but she was the first Black woman nominated for a primetime Emmy Award.
sentences.zh: 她虽然没获奖，但她是第一位获得黄金时段艾美奖提名的黑人女性。

sentences.en: She was also the first Black woman to win the Tony Award for Best Actress in a Musical for her role in the musical No Strings.
sentences.zh: 她还是第一位凭借音乐剧《无弦》中的角色获得托尼奖最佳音乐剧女主角的黑人女性。

sentences.en: She's very famous for playing Dominique Devereaux in the primetime soap opera Dynasty.
sentences.zh: 她因在黄金时段肥皂剧《豪门恩怨》中饰演多米尼克·德弗罗而闻名。

sentences.en: And she has appeared on Grey's Anatomy.
sentences.zh: 她还出演过《实习医生格蕾》。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm sort of noting all of the cameo stars.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我正在记录所有的客串明星。

sentences.en: These were, like, huge gets for this Star Wars special.
sentences.zh: 对于这部《星球大战》特辑来说，这些人简直是大牌中的大牌。

sentences.en: And we haven't even gotten to Bea Arthur yet.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还没提到碧·亚瑟呢。

sentences.en: Well, now Princess Leia and C-3PO are going to contact the Wookiees.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在莱娅公主和C-3PO要联系伍基人了。

sentences.en: And, lady, this conversation, it's like, I know we keep saying this where you're just kind of like, what?
sentences.zh: 天哪，这段对话，就像是，我知道我们一直在说，但你听了只会觉得，什么鬼？

sentences.en: I have to read it to you.
They come on the screen, and Princess Leia says to Mala, happy life day.
sentences.zh: 她们出现在屏幕上，莱娅公主对马拉说，生命日快乐。

sentences.en: And then Mala says a bunch of stuff, right?
sentences.zh: 然后马拉说了一堆话，对吧？

sentences.en: And then C-3PO translates and says, she says it might seem like a happy life day for you, but personally, she's seen happier ones.
sentences.zh: 接着C-3PO翻译说，她说对你来说这可能是个快乐的生命日，但就她个人而言，她见过更快乐的。

sentences.en: Princess Leia doesn't react at all.
sentences.zh: 莱娅公主完全没有反应。

sentences.en: She goes, I don't want to tie up the channels.
Can you put Wookiee or Han on the phone?
sentences.zh: 你能让伍基人或者汉接电话吗？

sentences.en: She's just told you she's upset.
She's like, yeah, can you put someone else on the phone?
sentences.zh: 而莱娅却说，好吧，你能让别人接电话吗？

sentences.en: Then Mala says a bunch more stuff, and basically they find out that they haven't arrived yet.
sentences.zh: 然后马拉又说了一堆，基本上她们发现他们还没到。

sentences.en: It's the same information that we started the special with.
sentences.zh: 这和我们特辑开头的信息一模一样。

sentences.en: We have to repeat it over and over again.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不一遍又一遍地重复它。

sentences.en: Everyone who Mala calls or anyone who calls Mala.
sentences.zh: 马拉打给的每个人，或者打给马拉的每个人都是这样。

sentences.en: But guess what Princess Leia's reaction is to this?
sentences.zh: 但你猜莱娅公主对此有什么反应？

sentences.en: And Mala says, no, I have a friend here.
sentences.zh: 马拉说，不，我有个朋友在这里。

sentences.en: And Leia goes, can I talk to him?
sentences.zh: 然后莱娅说，我能和他说话吗？

sentences.en: Why can't Mala speak for herself?
sentences.zh: 为什么马拉不能自己说话？

sentences.en: So now Sean Dan comes to the screen, and Leia asks him to take care of the Wookiees until Chewie's arrival, and that she'll be contacting him again soon.
sentences.zh: 所以现在肖丹出现在屏幕上，莱娅让他照顾好伍基人直到楚巴卡到达，并说她很快会再联系他。
马拉明明能听懂她的话。

sentences.en: She could have just said that right to Mala.
sentences.zh: 她本可以直接跟马拉说的。

sentences.en: It's not like Sean Dan then translates it into Wookiee.
sentences.zh: 又不是说肖恩·丹还要把它翻译成伍基语。

sentences.en: It's just hilarious to me that Princess Leia just keeps saying, is there someone else I can talk to?
sentences.zh: 我觉得特别好笑的是，莱娅公主一直在问，我能和别人谈谈吗？

sentences.en: We're back on the Millennium Falcon.
sentences.zh: 我们回到了千年隼号上。

sentences.en: Han Solo decides they need to land on the north side of the planet for safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 汉·索罗决定为了安全起见，他们需要降落在星球的北侧。

sentences.en: There's just too much Imperial traffic.
sentences.zh: 那里的帝国军交通往来太频繁了。

sentences.en: It's going to be a long walk.
Now there is a commotion in the Wookiee home.
sentences.zh: 现在伍基人的家里一阵骚动。

sentences.en: Mala and Lumpy assume that it is Chewbacca who has arrived at laSt.
sentences.zh: 马拉和兰皮以为是楚巴卡终于到了。

sentences.en: So she opens her front door only to discover two stormtroopers and an Imperial officer.
sentences.zh: 于是她打开前门，却发现外面站着两个冲锋队员和一个帝国军官。

sentences.en: They sort of scan the place, and then they say, all right, this unit is occupied by four Wookiees, two males and one adult female and one male child.
sentences.zh: 他们大概搜查了一下，然后说，好吧，这间屋子住了四个伍基人，两个成年男性，一个成年女性，还有一个雄性幼崽。

sentences.en: The first thing they're going to do is check out Sean Dan's identification, and it checks out.
sentences.zh: 他们做的第一件事就是检查肖恩·丹的身份证明，检查结果没问题。

sentences.en: He kind of growls at the guard, and Sean is trying to get Mala to come in the kitchen because he has a plan.
sentences.zh: 他对着守卫低吼，肖恩试图让马拉进厨房，因为他有个计划。

sentences.en: He's going to try to distract the stormtroopers, and he plays that music video box, which I think is the gift that he gave her, for one of the stormtroopers,
sentences.zh: 他打算分散冲锋队员的注意力，于是他给其中一个冲锋队员播放了那个音乐视频盒，我想那是他送给她的礼物，
然后他看着杰斐逊星船乐队的表演。

sentences.en: I was very confused because what are they distracting them from?
sentences.zh: 我当时很困惑，因为他们为什么要分散他们的注意力呢？

sentences.en: They're keeping them in the home by engaging them in this music box.
sentences.zh: 他们通过这个音乐盒把他们留在了家里。

sentences.en: But really, everybody, this is an excuse to get a performance from Jefferson Starship.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，各位，这只是为了让杰斐逊星船乐队表演的一个借口。

sentences.en: Taking you back in time, Jefferson Starship was huge.
sentences.zh: 带大家回顾一下，杰斐逊星船乐队当年非常火。

sentences.en: They were originally Jefferson Airplane, and you might know their hit, Somebody to Love.
sentences.zh: 他们前身是杰斐逊飞机乐队，你们可能听过他们的热门歌曲《Somebody to Love》。

sentences.en: When the truth is found to be...
They were a very popular band.
sentences.zh: 他们曾是一个非常受欢迎的乐队。

sentences.en: In fact, they were one of the pioneering bands of psychedelic rock.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们是迷幻摇滚的先驱乐队之一。

sentences.en: Two songs from their breakout album, Surrealistic Pillow, were on Rolling Stone's list of 500 greatest songs of all time.
sentences.zh: 他们成名专辑《Surrealistic Pillow》中的两首歌登上了《滚石》杂志史上最伟大的500首歌曲榜单。

sentences.en: One was Somebody to Love, and the other was White Rabbit.
sentences.zh: 一首是《Somebody to Love》，另一首是《White Rabbit》。

sentences.en: But shortly before this special came out, they had broken up, and a few of the original band members created a new band called Jefferson Starship.
sentences.zh: 但在这次特别节目播出前不久，他们解散了，几位原乐队成员组建了一个新乐队，叫杰斐逊星船。

sentences.en: All things that are in the sky.

sentences.zh: 这让我们有点晕头转向了。

sentences.en: Breaking this down is making us loopy.
sentences.zh: 深究这些让我们晕头转向。

sentences.en: Well, in this special, they played a song that they wrote called Light the Sky on Fire.
sentences.zh: 在这个特别节目中，他们演唱了一首自己写的歌，叫《点燃天空》。

sentences.en: During production, though, the song was given a different title.
sentences.zh: 不过在制作过程中，这首歌曾用过另一个标题。

sentences.en: This was the working title of the song.
So this is what would have been, like, on a script.
sentences.zh: 所以这大概就是剧本上会写的东西。

sentences.en: Like, now Jefferson Starship plays this song.
sentences.zh: 比如，现在杰斐逊星船要表演这首歌了。

sentences.en: They changed it to Light the Sky on Fire when they released it, but the working title was, and I can't believe this didn't stick.
sentences.zh: 他们发行时改成了《点燃天空》，但暂定名是——我真不敢相信这个名字没留下来。

sentences.en: Because it rolls off the tongue.
Can you believe that that name didn't stick?
sentences.zh: 你能相信那个名字没留下来吗？

sentences.en: Cigar-shaped object vanished without a trace, was the original title of the song.
sentences.zh: 《雪茄状物体消失得无影无踪》是这首歌最初的标题。

sentences.en: This appearance marked Marty Balin's final appearance with Jefferson Starship.
sentences.zh: 这次亮相是马蒂·巴林最后一次以杰斐逊星船成员身份出现。

sentences.en: He was one of the members who broke off.
sentences.zh: 他是脱离乐队的成员之一。

sentences.en: The lyrics of the song mention a, quote, great god.
sentences.zh: 歌词里提到了一个，引用一下，伟大的神。

sentences.en: Oh, here, this might be it.
They mention a great god named Copacan who, quote, came from the stars and vanished.
sentences.zh: 他们提到了一个叫科帕坎的伟大神灵，引用一下，来自群星并消失了。
所以科帕坎是雪茄形状的吗？

sentences.en: Do we hear about this person later in Star Wars?
sentences.zh: 我们之后在《星球大战》里还会听到这个人吗？

sentences.en: Well, the version that they played on the special was never released, but a shortened single was released.
sentences.zh: 他们在特别节目中演唱的版本从未发行，但发行了一个缩短后的单曲版。

sentences.en: But rather than listen to it, Angela, I would like to instead take you back to the late 80s.
sentences.zh: 但安吉拉，比起听那首歌，我更想带你回到80年代末。

sentences.en: So that we can listen to this song by Jefferson Starship.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就能听杰斐逊星船乐队的这首歌了。

sentences.en: I'll get up and dance with you.
sentences.zh: 我会起身和你一起跳舞。

sentences.en: Get my high tops with my scrunchie socks.
sentences.zh: 穿上我的高帮运动鞋和堆堆袜。
我们需要这种调剂一下心情。

sentences.en: That was the song that we couldn't wait to come on at the Mixers when I was in 7th and 8th grade.
sentences.zh: 那是我上七八年级参加舞会时，最盼望听到的歌。

sentences.en: Well, we're basically going to go now from a five-minute musical performance to a 10-minute cartoon.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们现在基本上要从五分钟的音乐表演转到十分钟的动画片了。

sentences.en: You know, Lumpy, he kind of growls at a guard.
sentences.zh: 你知道，兰比对着一名守卫咆哮。

sentences.en: And the stormtrooper's like, really mean.
sentences.zh: 那个冲锋队队员非常凶。

sentences.en: They shove Itchy to the ground.
The general says, keep them quiet or else.
sentences.zh: 将军说，让他们安静点，否则后果自负。

sentences.en: So Mala puts on one of Lumpy's favorite cartoons.
sentences.zh: 于是马拉放了一部兰比最喜欢的动画片。

sentences.en: He's like, what's this all about?
sentences.zh: 他问，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And then quickly, Lumpy pretends to be playing like a video game.
sentences.zh: 然后兰比赶紧假装在玩电子游戏。

sentences.en: And then when he walks away, it cuts to he's watching this cartoon.
sentences.zh: 等那人走开后，画面切到他正在看动画片。

sentences.en: Why he couldn't know that he's watching a cartoon, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 为什么那人会不知道他在看动画片，我也不清楚。

sentences.zh: 她那表情，真的太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Well, they don't make a lot of different facial expressions.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们确实做不出太多不同的面部表情。

sentences.en: Well, Han is going to leave.
Where is he going for life?
Harrison Ford just looked happy to exit stage right.
sentences.zh: 哈里森·福特看起来只是很高兴能从舞台右侧退场。

sentences.en: But no sooner is the family reunited than another Imperial officer appears on the screen.
sentences.zh: 但一家人刚团聚，屏幕上又出现了一名帝国军官。

sentences.en: They've already discovered that this stormtrooper is missing.
sentences.zh: 他们已经发现这个冲锋队员不见了。

sentences.en: And this is why I think that they can't see you.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我觉得他们看不见你。

sentences.en: Because then Sean Dan is like, I got this.
sentences.zh: 因为接着肖恩·丹说，这事我来搞定。
他输入了自己的身份信息。

sentences.en: He's like, he robbed me and went off to the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 他说，他抢劫了我然后跑进森林里去了。

sentences.en: And they're like, thank you very much.
We'll go send out a search party.
Are they just leaving this stormtrooper's body at the bottom of this tree thing?
sentences.zh: 他们就打算把这个冲锋队员的尸体留在树底下吗？

sentences.en: Also, how do you get up there?
How did you get on the front porch of this thing?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么到这东西的前廊上去的？

sentences.en: It's just, it's built around a tree really high up.
sentences.zh: 它就是建在一棵树上，位置很高。

sentences.en: Like, do you zip line in?
How do you get to the balcony to the front door?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么到前门的阳台上去的？
就像那种小型的自动扶梯。

sentences.en: Seriously, are they going to bury this?
sentences.zh: 说真的，他们打算把这事儿掩盖过去吗？

sentences.en: They're just like, oh, they're tricked them.
sentences.zh: 他们就像是，噢，他们把他们骗了。

sentences.en: There's a lot of things you've got to just make a mental jump for.
sentences.zh: 有很多事情你得靠脑补才能接受。

sentences.en: How do you get into the tree house?
sentences.zh: 你到底是怎么进到树屋里的？

sentences.en: Well, with the danger now passed, Chewbacca's family prepares to attend the Life Day Festival.
sentences.zh: 好了，随着危险解除，楚巴卡一家准备去参加生命日庆典了。

sentences.en: There's these gold glowing orbs and they're wearing red robes.
sentences.zh: 那里有一些金色的发光球体，他们穿着红色的长袍。

sentences.en: They kind of look like they're in a church choir.
sentences.zh: 看起来有点像教堂唱诗班。

sentences.en: And somehow they, are they teleported to this tree of life ceremony?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么……是被传送到这个生命之树的仪式现场了吗？

sentences.en: I'll have you know, in the Star Wars, the Life Day cookbook, it's not just food recipes.
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你，《星球大战：生命日食谱》里可不只有食物配方。

sentences.en: There are also instructions on how to decorate and dress for the holiday.
sentences.zh: 里面还有关于如何装饰和穿着以迎接节日的说明。

sentences.en: So you can make a Life Day orb, if you'd like.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你愿意的话，你可以做一个生命日圆球。

sentences.en: Here is how you're going to do it.
You are going to buy 12 clear glass ornaments.
sentences.zh: 你需要买12个透明玻璃装饰球。

sentences.en: And basically, pour glass paint into a paper bowl.
sentences.zh: 基本上，把玻璃漆倒进纸碗里。

sentences.en: Hold the ornament by the top.
Dip it in the paint about a third of the way up.
sentences.zh: 把它浸入漆中，大约三分之一的高度。

sentences.en: And then when it's dry, put a balloon light inside.
sentences.zh: 干了之后，把气球灯放进去。

sentences.en: Or would you like to make a Life Day robe?
sentences.zh: 或者你想做一件生命日长袍吗？

sentences.en: Can I just order one for my church?
sentences.zh: 我可以给我的教会订购一件吗？

sentences.en: You're going to need two yards of red fabric.
And two yards of red ribbon.
Measure the fabric to the desired length of the robe.
sentences.zh: 量好布料，裁出长袍所需的长度。

sentences.en: Cut a hole in the top.
And then tie a ribbon around your waiSt.
This is what you do, like, if you want to be a ghost at Halloween, but you didn't get
sentences.zh: 这就像是万圣节你想扮鬼，但没来得及准备服装，

sentences.en: your costume in time, so you just cut a hole in a pillowcase for your kid and...
sentences.zh: 于是就给孩子在枕套上剪个洞，然后……

sentences.en: This did not need a page in a book.
sentences.zh: 这根本没必要专门写进书里。

sentences.en: That's some fluff at the end of the book.
sentences.zh: 那是书末尾凑数的内容。

sentences.en: Take us to the end of this.
So, everybody pretty much is all gathered together.
sentences.zh: 大家差不多都聚在一起了。

sentences.en: There's a lot of folks in robes.
And Princess Leia has a pretty big speech and then goes into song.
sentences.zh: 莱娅公主发表了一番感人至深的演讲，然后唱起了歌。

sentences.en: I think we should hear it.
This holiday is yours, but we all share with you the hope that this day brings us closer
sentences.zh: 这个节日属于你们，但我们都与你们分享这份希望，愿这一天让我们更接近

sentences.en: to freedom and to harmony and to peace.
No matter how different we appear, we're all the same in our struggle against the powers
sentences.zh: 无论我们外表看起来有多么不同，在对抗邪恶与黑暗势力的斗争中，

sentences.en: I hope that this day will always be a day of joy in which we can reconfirm our dedication
sentences.zh: 我希望这一天永远是充满喜悦的一天，让我们能重申我们的奉献精神

sentences.en: and our courage and, more than anything else, our love for one another.
sentences.zh: 以及我们的勇气，最重要的是，我们彼此之间的爱。

sentences.en: This is the promise of the tree of life.
This reminds me so much of how I try to sing good at church.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起我在教堂努力唱歌的样子。

sentences.en: It's got a little bit of that for me, though.
sentences.zh: 不过对我来说，确实有那么一点感觉。

sentences.en: This, incidentally, you're hearing it now, this is set to the main title, music for Star
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，你们现在听到的这段音乐，是约翰·威廉姆斯为《星球大战》

sentences.en: Yes, it starts to come in there.
As she sings this, everyone slowly files out.
sentences.zh: 当她唱这首歌时，大家慢慢地排队走了出去。

sentences.en: Everyone in their robes that they cut a hole in and tied a ribbon around their waist, they're
sentences.zh: 每个人都穿着长袍，袍子上剪了个洞，腰间系着丝带，他们

sentences.en: all filing out, and the camera pushes in on Chewbacca's face.
sentences.zh: 全都排队走了出去，镜头推向楚巴卡的脸。

sentences.en: He's kind of looking off in the distance, and we see a montage of scenes from the first
sentences.zh: 他若有所思地望着远方，我们看到了一段《星球大战》第一部电影的

sentences.en: Star Wars movie, and then it comes back to Chewbacca and his family, and they're sitting
sentences.zh: 剪辑片段，然后镜头回到楚巴卡和他的家人身上，他们正坐下来

sentences.en: down for dinner with the gold orbs in the center of their table.
sentences.zh: 吃晚餐，桌子中央放着金色的球体。

sentences.en: They bow their heads as if to pray, and the credits roll.
sentences.zh: 他们低下头仿佛在祈祷，随后字幕滚动。
好了，各位，这就是全部内容了。

sentences.en: You are no longer allowed to write into Dear Office, ladies.
sentences.zh: 女士们，你们以后不准再写信给“亲爱的办公室”栏目了。

sentences.en: I just want you to know you've been banned.
sentences.zh: 我只想让你们知道，你们已经被禁了。

sentences.en: I want to know what your review of it, like how many stars out of 10?
sentences.zh: 我想知道你们的评价，满分10分给几颗星？
也许给比·亚瑟一颗星吧。

sentences.en: IMDb rates it at 2.2 out of 10.
sentences.zh: IMDb给它的评分是2.2分（满分10分）。

sentences.en: Arthur gets a star for me, and so does that first stormtrooper that says, I hate fish.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟对我来说值得一颗星，还有那个说“我讨厌鱼”的冲锋队员也值得一颗。

sentences.en: He gets maybe one and a half star.
Well, maybe he gets a star.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许他能得一颗星。

sentences.en: Here's what I think it is.
He gets a star, and then a half a star for the stormtrooper who doesn't like fish.
sentences.zh: 他得了一颗星，然后那个不喜欢鱼的冲锋队队员得了半颗星。

sentences.en: And Jenna, can I ask, do you still consider yourself a Star Wars fan?
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我能问一下吗，你还认为自己是《星球大战》的粉丝吗？

sentences.en: Well, I never considered myself a fan.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我从来没把自己当成粉丝。

sentences.en: This didn't turn the tides for you?
No, it did not turn me into a Star Wars fan.
sentences.zh: 没有，它没能让我变成《星球大战》的粉丝。

sentences.en: Ainsley, have you ever seen Star Wars?
sentences.zh: 安斯利，你看过《星球大战》吗？

sentences.en: I have no idea what happened.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: I liked those three, but I'm stopping.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那三部，但我打算就此打住。

sentences.en: I don't need to see any more of the world.
sentences.zh: 我不需要再看这个世界的更多内容了。

sentences.en: But I really did enjoy Star Wars, Empire Strikes Back, and Return of the Jedi.
sentences.zh: 但我确实很喜欢《星球大战》、《帝国反击战》和《绝地归来》。
但也就到此为止了，我结束了。

sentences.en: I will watch all of them.
This is my least favorite in the fandom.
sentences.zh: 这是我在整个系列中最不喜欢的一部。

sentences.en: But I will watch them all.
sentences.zh: 但我会把它们全部看完。

sentences.en: Well, a big thank you to Ainsley for joining us today for this recording.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢安斯利今天来参加我们的录制。

sentences.en: And thank you so much for your outline.
We're sorry, but we had to have you here with us to bear witness to this moment.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，但我们必须让你在这里和我们一起见证这一刻。

sentences.en: And we feel like, as a gift, you should be the one to take home the Star Wars Life Day cookbook.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得，作为礼物，你应该把这本《星球大战》生命日食谱带回家。

sentences.en: I am so honored, and I will take it.
sentences.zh: 我深感荣幸，我会收下的。

sentences.en: Please make one of the robes and show it to us someday.
sentences.zh: 请一定要做一道里面的菜，改天展示给我们看。

sentences.en: Well, everyone, if you have an idea for an upcoming Office Ladies 6.0 episode, we'd love to hear from you.
sentences.zh: 各位，如果你对即将到来的《办公室女郎》6.0集有什么想法，我们很乐意听听。

sentences.en: And if your name is Cassie, sorry, do not.
sentences.zh: 如果你的名字叫凯西，抱歉，请不要提。

sentences.en: Angela is going to post a link to our Dear Office Ladies mailbag in the Office Ladies pod stories today.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉今天会在《办公室女郎》的播客故事里发布一个链接，通往我们的“亲爱的办公室女郎”信箱。

sentences.en: And remember, it can really be any topic.
Just what do you want to hear us talk about?
sentences.zh: 你到底想听我们聊些什么？

sentences.en: Please, though, can I have a break from fantasy sci-fi?
sentences.zh: 不过拜托，能让我从奇幻科幻题材里休息一下吗？

sentences.en: Can we make Angela watch a horror movie?
sentences.zh: 我们能让安吉拉看一部恐怖片吗？

sentences.en: No, I don't want to watch a horror movie.
Write in and let us know.
And please join us next Wednesday for our interview with Kathy Bates.
sentences.zh: 下周三请继续收听我们对凯西·贝茨的采访。

sentences.en: This sherbet and stew are such a disgusting combo.
sentences.zh: 这雪酪和炖菜搭配在一起真是恶心透了。

sentences.en: It's coming back on me in a gross, gross way.
sentences.zh: 那种味道一直在反胃，真是太恶心了。

sentences.en: I think we should end on that.
sentences.zh: 我想我们该就此结束了。
